name: Wordwood
subject: Natural Language Processing
description: Wander a wood where the trees are words and the paths are sentences: how computers split and tidy text, count what comes next, sort and tag it, remember context, give words a place on a map and weigh every word against the rest.
bigFact: Standard attention in a transformer compares every word with every other word, so doubling the length of a text makes that work grow four times.
